name: In Service of Zephras

aliases: what happens in service of zephras
faq.answer: In Service of Zephras tasks the player with reporting to Valennia Stormfist on behalf of the High Order. The High Order previously attempted to steer clear of direct violence with the Al'Aketh cult, but mounting hostilities and reports of large-scale cult troop maneuvers around the island forced their hand. The quest establishes formal High Order support for Valanaar's defense, while also delivering solemn tidings concerning the fate of Belathaan.
faq.q: What is the quest In Service of Zephras about?

faq.answer: Valennia Stormfist is a leader coordinating defensive efforts against the Al'Aketh in Valanaar. When the High Order sends an emissary to pledge their allegiance, Valennia receives the offer of mutual aid. She is also the cousin of Belathaan, a fallen servant of Zephras whose death is reported during this exchange, prompting her to swear vengeance against the cultists threatening their people.

Belathaan was a cousin of Valennia Stormfist and a dedicated servant of Zephras who perished prior to the events of this mission. Valennia remembers him as an honorable servant and defender of their cause. The news of his death is formally confirmed when the adventurer reports to Valennia, deepening the personal stakes of the conflict and reinforcing the vow to avenge him.

The Al'Aketh is a hostile cult active on the island whose aggressive maneuvers threaten the people of Zephras. Although the High Order initially attempted to avoid provoking direct confrontations with them, recent hostile displays and ominous reports of widespread cult movements have made war unavoidable. Their expansion has forced local forces and the High Order into an armed alliance to repel them.

aliases: why is the high order fighting
faq.answer: The High Order initially attempted to avoid direct warfare with the Al'Aketh cult, preferring a restrained approach. However, aggressive actions and rumors of large-scale cult mobilizations convinced their leadership that neutrality was no longer sustainable. By dispatching a courier to Valennia Stormfist, the High Order officially commits its full strength to support Valanaar's military resistance against the cult.
faq.q: What is the High Order's role in this conflict?

faq.answer: Zephras refers to the people, realm, or patron entity for whom the region's protectors fight. The High Order explicitly warns that the rising cult movements bode ill for the people of Zephras, and fallen champions like Belathaan are remembered as faithful servants of Zephras. Protecting its populace serves as the primary justification for the alliance against the Al'Aketh.

sections.body: For a time, the High Order sought to minimize open hostility with the secretive Al'Aketh cult, attempting to prevent outright warfare across the island. That fragile stance collapsed as the cult demonstrated unmistakable hostility, backed by alarming reports of large-scale troop movements. Recognizing that the cultists are mobilizing for an operation that threatens the peace and safety of every settlement, the High Order has shifted toward decisive action. Rather than remaining passive observers, they have resolved to commit their strength to an active alliance, sending an emissary to coordinate with local defenders before the Al'Aketh strike.
sections.title: The Gathering Threat

sections.body: To meet the rising cultist threat, the emissary is dispatched to Valennia Stormfist to officially offer the High Order's unconditional assistance in Valanaar's resistance against the Al'Aketh. The communication establishes a united defensive front between the two factions, paving the way for joint military efforts across the region. However, the mission carries a heavy personal cost: upon arrival, the traveler must deliver news concerning the demise of Belathaan, Valennia's cousin and a devoted servant of Zephras. While mourning his loss, Valennia vows vengeance, turning shared grief into immediate preparation for the upcoming campaign.
sections.title: Alliance with Valanaar

summary: In Service of Zephras is a quest in which an adventurer carries word from the High Order pledging their full military and diplomatic support to Valanaar against the Al'Aketh cult. Escalating hostile movements across the island have forced the High Order to abandon their policy of avoiding direct confrontation with the cultists. Upon delivering the message to Valennia Stormfist, the envoy also brings grim news regarding the death of her cousin Belathaan, solidifying a joint resolve to protect the people of Zephras.
